name: resilience
label: RESILIENCE
title: Resilience: the server changes, the client doesn't break
summary: When the server changes, or misbehaves on purpose, the client takes the failure path the spec names, re-syncs, and goes on; a model comes back only when the controls really changed, to repair. At the small scale it is the regression suite and the gates that hold, even against the model.
